windows.app_release_notes: v1.10.0 - Measure your targets in inches, MOA or mil. Factory ammo is now a load you can save and compare. Loadscope reopens at the size you left it. Plus fixes to seating-depth tests: the powder charge now shows on the printed cards, DOPE works on a seating-only load, and a CBTO ladder no longer reads as a jump.
